newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yemen rolls over Q4 Masila, Marib Light prices.
newsitem.headline: Yemen rolls over Q4 Masila, Marib Light prices.

text.p: Yemen has rolled over its official fourth-quarter Masila crude oil price to maintain it at dated Brent minus 45 cents, the Yemen government said in a news release on Tuesday.
The price of Marib Light crude for the fourth quarter was also rolled over at dated Brent flat, Yemen's Supreme Council for Economy & Oil Affairs said in a statement.
In the second-quarter, Masila was priced at dated Brent minus 20 cents and Marib Light at dated Brent plus 15 cents.
Yemen exports 75,000 barrels of Masila and 35,000 barrels of Marib Light per day.
